verdict.rationale: Trilegal is an Indian full-service law firm, not a software or data-hosting product, so letting users choose a data storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. Its DPDPA advisory content and India-only office footprint are legal advisory and physical-location facts, not a user-selectable data residency capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
